headline: Synergies lift margins; reported growth is deal-driven

drivers.explanation: Primarily the Interpublic acquisition, which closed November 26, 2025, plus constant-currency growth; core operations grew 7.3% including 7.2% organic.
Core margin rose to 18.2% from 16.2% on cost-reduction synergies and organic revenue growth.
Management is on track for $900 million of cost synergies in 2026, with integration nearly complete.

summary_short: Omnicom reported Q3 revenue of $6.4B, with 7.2% organic growth in core operations, diluted EPS of $2.38 and adjusted EPS of $2.73 (+21.9%).
summary_long: Reported revenue is not like-for-like with last year because Interpublic was acquired in November 2025. Core operations revenue was $6.0B with 18.2% adjusted EBITA margin versus 16.2%. Q3 included a $106.8M gain on a subsidiary disposition and $125.1M of repositioning and integration costs. Net interest expense rose to $104.2M on assumed IPG debt. Targeting $900M of synergies in 2026.
confidence_notes: Prior-year reported figures exclude Interpublic; y/y reported deltas are inflated by the acquisition. Adjusted measures are company-defined non-GAAP.
